title: Fix the Memory Leak in a Loop
description: The program should allocate and process 5 small buffers, freeing each before moving to the next.
expectedBehavior: The program should allocate, use, and properly release each of the 5 buffers, leaking no memory.
actualProblem: A new buffer is allocated on every loop iteration, but none of them are ever freed — buffer goes out of scope at the end of each iteration, and its address (the only way to free that memory) is lost, permanently leaking that memory for the rest of the program's run.
explanation: Every successful malloc() must eventually be paired with a matching free() once the memory is no longer needed. Allocating inside a loop without freeing at the end of each iteration leaks a little more memory on every pass.
